cases.fullName: ML3 renders at most three poisoned records as bounded historical-only context
cases.invariant: Host rendering labels recalled bytes as historical evidence and enforces three-record and 1024-token or eight-percent bounds.

cases.fullName: ML3 removes a source that becomes stale after ranking and before context use
cases.invariant: A ranked record is refetched from canonical storage and source-revalidated immediately before ContextPlan use.

cases.fullName: ML3 historical context cannot displace protected facts or mutate model tools
cases.invariant: Historical records stay low priority and outside the protected ledger while the exact Host tool schema is preserved.

cases.fullName: ML3 Session B uses a relevant Session A episode in a new process
cases.invariant: An explicit local-memory Agent request in a new process contains the source-available prior episode and its selection explanation.

cases.fullName: ML3 off and remote-provider paths inject zero memory records
cases.invariant: Default or explicit off is behavior-neutral and provider-network requests never open a retrieval projection or receive memory records.
